collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-22  -  THE GIFT WITHOUT A NAME SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A villager notices that an elderly neighbor's carrying basket is badly worn and quietly begins weaving a replacement.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A villager notices that an elderly neighbor's carrying basket is badly worn and quietly begins weaving a replacement.

choices.label: Leave the Finished Basket as an Anonymous Gift.
Ask Whether the Neighbor Would Prefer a Repair.
Invite Other Villagers to Contribute Materials.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The neighbor finds it useful and wonders who made it.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The neighbor worries it belongs to someone else and asks around before using it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The neighbor accepts with gratitude and offers to share an old weaving pattern.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The neighbor politely declines, preferring to repair the original basket.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The damage proves extensive, and the neighbor accepts the new basket instead.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Several small contributions make the replacement especially sturdy.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Few materials are available, so the weaver finishes a simpler design.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: Together they strengthen the old basket, preserving its familiar shape.
